updates.problem: RAKL previously distinguished GLUE and JUMP but lacked an executable contract for lifting an unresolved target to a candidate shared generator, using sibling realizations, and projecting only witnessed generator structure back.
updates.result: Typed LIFT/PROJECT support now distinguishes category, parent, abstract-schema, mechanism-family and shared-generator relations and cannot grant target authority.
updates.remaining_gap: No real scientific comparative-generator benchmark has yet established target-hypothesis utility.

updates.problem: A shared generator name or equation form can be vacuous unless source/target interventions or registered queries agree through the instance-to-generator maps.
updates.target: Require common registered intervention/query probes and explicit commutation outcomes for strong generator/mechanism-family transfer hypotheses.
updates.falsifier: If known valid generator relations systematically fail this requirement because the correct scientific relation is observational/non-interventional, split the relation type rather than weakening all generator witnesses.

updates.problem: Many papers or analogies can descend from one theory, dataset, benchmark or intellectual lineage and therefore overstate corroboration.
updates.target: Build explicit evidence-lineage graphs and estimate independence/effective support separately from source count; preserve unknown ancestry.
updates.falsifier: If lineage-aware weighting does not reduce false corroboration on frozen duplicated-ancestry worlds, retain provenance only and avoid extra scoring complexity.

updates.problem: Hard GLUE forces sibling systems into one template while no-sharing discards genuine common structure.
updates.target: Compare generator-core plus instance-specific Delta_i representations against hard merge and no-sharing baselines under matched evidence/cost budgets.
updates.falsifier: If partial pooling does not improve generator discrimination, transfer utility or outlier robustness, keep instance maps separate without a pooled generator state.

updates.problem: An unresolved target can have several residual-relevant parents/generators; a single ontology parent can trap search in the wrong abstraction.
updates.target: Generate and rank a non-greedy lattice/portfolio of candidate parents from shared attributes, mechanisms, equations, functions and regimes; compare against one-parent greedy LIFT.
updates.falsifier: If a simple single-parent heuristic matches candidate-lattice recall/utility at lower cost, retain the simple heuristic.

updates.problem: Similarity observed in one environment can reflect coincidence or shared surface context rather than a stable generator.
updates.target: Use materially heterogeneous environments/interventions as discriminating probes for the registered generator core while keeping regime-local relations scoped.
updates.falsifier: If the alleged generator changes under legitimate environments where it predicts invariance, reject or narrow the generator claim.

updates.problem: Synthetic contracts do not show that LIFT -> sibling search -> generator recognition -> PROJECT improves real scientific discovery.
updates.target: Freeze real sibling systems with expert-supported shared/competing generators, category-only false parents, regime-specific exceptions, outliers and target tests; compare direct target-only search against generator-mediated search under matched model/resource budgets.
updates.falsifier: If direct target-only search matches generator-mediated search on valid target transfer and cost, keep LIFT/JUMP/PROJECT optional rather than mandatory complexity.

updates.blocker: exact pinned MIR artifact bytes remain unavailable through the current runtime transport
updates.note: Do not treat the new generator support layer as evidence that real MIR route performance improved.

saturation.reason: Round 017 retained and implemented new generator-level transport, evidence-lineage and outlier-preserving method coordinates.
